name: @djgrant/hn/search
description: Hacker News stories via Algolia's HN Search, the first API-backed HN lens. Sorting happens server-side before pagination: order byPopularity queries the Item_dev index, byDate its _sort_date replica. An empty query browses all stories. Each story links onward to hn/item via item_url; next_page is the same search at the next page (null on the last). Pages are 0-based, matching Algolia.

resolve.items: { "stories": [hits.{ "id": objectID, "title": title, "url": $exists(url) ? url : null, "author": author, "points": $exists(points) ? points : null, "comments": $exists(num_comments) ? num_comments : null, "item_url": objectID }], "next_page": page + 1 < nbPages ? page + 1 : null }

resolve.prompt: This is Algolia's Hacker News search UI. Each result reads as title(url) then 'points|author|age|comments'. Return {stories, next_page}: stories is the visible result list in order, each {id, title, url, author, points, comments} with points and comments as numbers (null when absent, e.g. Ask HN posts have no url); id is the story's numeric HN id if visible, otherwise omit the story. next_page is the next 0-based page number if the pagination control shows one after the current page, otherwise null.
